description: Authentication failures (invalid, expired or missing tokens) in a time window, grouped by API, error code and message, with first and last occurrence. Use for 'auth errors', 'invalid tokens', 'possible credential abuse'.

configuration.query: FROM apim_event_faulty | WHERE errorType == "AUTH" AND DATE_DIFF("minute", requestTimestamp, NOW()) <= ?lookback_minutes | STATS failures=COUNT(*), first_seen=MIN(requestTimestamp), last_seen=MAX(requestTimestamp) BY apiName, errorCode, errorMessage | SORT failures DESC | LIMIT 20

lookback_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes (e.g. 60 for the last hour, 1440 for a day).
